notes:
Highlights:
- Dependable restore: restoring a backup now reliably replaces your library and relaunches the app, so your data always comes back.
- Stable library: releases keep their real import date — no more old releases jumping to the top or showing NEW after background maintenance.
- Settings that stick: theme, sorting and appearance preferences survive app updates instead of resetting.
- Responsive imports: the activity queue shows progress immediately instead of appearing to hang while scanning large archives.
- Move-import placeholder: leaving a same-name empty file so download managers still see the file as already downloaded.
